name: WWII Eastern Front Invasion
causal_trigger: Nazi expansionist ideology & economic drive for wheat/oil resources following Great Depression.
description: The largest and bloodiest military theater in human history, characterized by total economic mobilization and unprecedented destruction.

name: Battle of Britain & Western Europe
causal_trigger: Fall of France and German attempt to achieve air superiority over the English Channel.
description: Air campaign and naval blockade followed by Allied counter-invasion across Western Europe.

name: North African Campaign
key_battles: First & Second Battles of El Alamein
causal_trigger: Fascist Italy's ambition for imperial expansion into Egypt and Suez Canal control.
description: Fierce tank battles across Libya and Egypt, pitting Axis forces against British Empire and Allied armies.

name: Second Italo-Ethiopian War
causal_trigger: Mussolini's drive to establish an Italian East African Empire to offset domestic economic tension.
description: Exposed the failure of the League of Nations and signaled the collapse of interwar international security.

name: Toyota War & Chadian-Libyan Conflict
causal_trigger: Libyan annexation of the Aouzou Strip and military intervention in Chadian civil strife.
description: Notable for mobile tactical warfare using light technical trucks ('Toyota War') routing heavily armored Libyan forces.

name: Darfur & Sudanese Civil Conflicts
causal_trigger: Economic marginilisation, oil wealth disputes, and autocratic centralization in Khartoum.
description: Decades-long conflict resulting in South Sudan's 2011 independence and severe humanitarian crises.

name: Great Lakes Chain Reaction (Congo Wars)
causal_trigger: 1994 Rwandan Genocide and massive refugee displacement across Eastern DRC border.
description: Often called 'Africa's World War', involving 9 African nations and leading to massive civil destruction.

name: Zimbabwean Intervention in DRC
causal_trigger: SADC intervention request and Mugabe's interest in securing Congolese diamond and mineral concessions.
description: Zimbabwe deployed thousands of troops to prop up Kabila's government, straining Zimbabwe's already weak economy.
